### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Send each agent turn with a token that lasts](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3205) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Long agent turns no longer stop part-way with `Unauthorized`: each message to an agent goes out with a sign-in token that has at least 25 of its 30 minutes left, refreshed silently when needed.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.17.3...v3.17.4
